overview.Description: Twenty One Capital, Inc. engages in the Bitcoin-related business. The company is involved in actively accumulating Bitcoin; and managing its Bitcoin holdings. It also develops educational materials and branded content for institutional and retail investor Bitcoin literacy. Twenty One Capital, Inc. is based in Austin, Texas.
